summary: Prepare deferred incremental namespaces outside the admission writer

replay.detail: No automatic startup/read history replay. Source owners explicitly page extraction and consume retained immutable references.

schema.detail: Opt-in Installer creates deferred-source configuration/journal integrity triggers. Explicit installed registration adds indexed source availability notifications. No default Store schema migration or production activation.

rules.detail: No admission, authority, canonical order or checkpoint rule change. Native source/dependency completeness remains owner-certified.

compatibility.detail: New deferred mode refuses synchronous Installer callbacks. Existing synchronous operators stay supported. Prepared namespace writes require ordinary full-PK tables without triggers or foreign-key edges.

downtime.detail: No automatic activation or restart. Existing source lifetimes are not converted.

manual.detail: An adapter explicitly enables a fresh deferred source lifetime, retains immutable input references and schedules owned off-writer preparation with bounded publication.

recovery.detail: Queue loss/exhaustion fences derived state; raw valid admission survives logical gaps. Database errors propagate. Stale prepared pages roll back and must be prepared again. Fresh complete namespace publication is required for recovery.
